title: Transfer Purpose Points on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credits
content:
Customer care purpose schedule for **Mobile Wallet** re-credits after money went to the wrong wallet.

**Purpose points.** The purpose points of a wrong-wallet re-credit follow the transfer purpose stated at booking together with the principal collected on the transfer (its funds-received entries):

| Stated transfer purpose | Principal collected at least 500.00 | Purpose points |
|---|---|---|
| education or medical | yes | 0.25 |
| family support | yes | 0.10 |
| education, medical or family support | no (below 500.00) | nothing |
| any other purpose | either | nothing |

*Hypothetical cases:* a medical transfer of 500.00 earns 0.25; a family support transfer of 750.00 earns 0.10; an education transfer of 499.99 earns nothing.
